pairs.name: mirror
pairs.alt: The harbour town, original left and with Mirror right: the left half of the bay is reflected onto the right across the middle, so the mountain becomes one symmetric peak above a round harbour, with the boats and quays mirrored on both sides
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Mirror at its defaults, Left / Right on.

pairs.name: rgb-split
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with RGB Split right: a red copy of her sits to the left and a blue copy to the right, so her white dress and raised arm carry red and blue fringes on either side, while the stage lights stay soft
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: RGB Split with Amount 0.012.

pairs.name: blockify
pairs.alt: The harbour town in a compare slider, original left and with Blockify right: the houses, boats and water rebuilt from square blocks in a few flat colours, with a fine checker of blocks where the sky and the sea change shade
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Blockify at its default settings. A detail.
